intro_paragraph: Pune's dating scene is shaped by its huge student and young-professional population, drawn in by the city's IT parks, colleges, and research institutes. That means a lot of people cycling in and out of the city every few years — which also means a lot of surface-level matches on apps built purely around swiping.
local_note: With a constant flow of students and early-career professionals moving through areas like Koregaon Park, Baner, and Hinjewadi, Pune's dating pool skews young and often short-term. That's not a bad thing — it just means matching on shared values and intent matters more here than in cities with a more settled population.
faq_best_app: InyeonAI is a strong option in Pune for people who want matching based on personality and intent rather than just proximity and photos. Traditional swipe apps also have a large presence in Pune given the student and IT-professional population.

intro_paragraph: Jaipur has a growing base of dating app users, but the market outside a few metro cities in India is generally thinner on mainstream swipe apps — which makes match quality more important than match quantity.
local_note: Jaipur's dating culture tends to be more relationship-oriented than some metro cities, with many users looking for something more serious rather than casual, short-term matches. A smaller, more intentional user base benefits from an app that filters by compatibility rather than relying on sheer volume.
faq_best_app: InyeonAI works well in Jaipur precisely because match quality matters more than raw user volume in tier-2 cities. Its personality-based matching helps surface people who are actually compatible rather than just nearby.
